description.text:
The first POP Series set: 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in two-card packs at its leagues and tournaments. In August 2004 Organized Play announced a new 17-card set every six months, only for the events it sanctioned, and most POP cards had first come out as Japanese promos. POP Series 1 reached leagues in late August and early September 2004 and stayed their packs for the whole 2004-2005 season: each season's league kit held 20 of them. Players at that season's City Championships each got a pack along with a stamped Machop.

Every card in the packs is non-holo, the ex cards too. Holo copies came later in shop products: Sceptile and Swampert in EX Unseen Forces blisters (November 2005), Blaziken and Metagross in EX Legend Maker blisters (March 2006), Rayquaza in EX Holon Phantoms blisters (May 2006) and Tyranitar ex in a Target value box (October 2006). The Taiwan PokéPark gave its visitors a Chinese-language Rayquaza on 24 September 2006.
